speaker: vanguard
text: I had that under control, but thanks!

speaker: riftweaver
text: You're welcome. Try not to test my reflexes twice in a minute.

speaker: riftweaver
text: A second later and that would have left a mark.

speaker: vanguard
text: Good thing my shield has your schedule memorized.

speaker: vanguard
text: Remind me to buy you dinner for that one.

speaker: riftweaver
text: I'm holding you to that. Somewhere with hot bread.

speaker: riftweaver
text: On your feet, hero. We haven't finished this page.

speaker: vanguard
text: Never in doubt with you beside me.

speaker: vanguard
text: Shards everywhere! That's the shatter!

speaker: riftweaver
text: You froze them in place; I just delivered the punchline.

speaker: riftweaver
text: Thunderclap! The whole pool is dancing!

speaker: vanguard
text: Lightning looks good on your side of the fight.

speaker: vanguard
text: Resonance! Perfect timing!

speaker: riftweaver
text: Right on cue!

speaker: vanguard
text: Into the masonry! That's gotta hurt.

speaker: riftweaver
text: Mind the architecture, darling.

speaker: any
text: It's reeling! Double Tech window, now!

speaker: riftweaver
text: Staggered! Hit it with everything we have!

speaker: any
text: Bond meter's peaked! Call the Double Tech whenever you're ready.

speaker: vanguard
text: Together! Hearthflare!

speaker: riftweaver
text: Two halves, one strike!

speaker: riftweaver
text: Tether's stretching thin, keep within reach!

speaker: vanguard
text: You're drifting too far! Get back inside the light!

speaker: riftweaver
text: Working on it! Had a few thralls to clear first.

speaker: any
text: Tether's locked back in. Good to have you close.

speaker: vanguard
text: Cold down here. Smells of drowned stone and old ink.

speaker: riftweaver
text: Watch the slick flagstones. The Abbess has had centuries to flood this place.

speaker: riftweaver
text: If we step in the water, shock or freeze will travel through the whole channel.

speaker: vanguard
text: Then we freeze the surface first and make our own road.

speaker: vanguard
text: Look at the size of that bell. If we slam him into it, the chime will rattle his bones.

speaker: riftweaver
text: Ring his bell for him. I'll line up the frost.

speaker: riftweaver
text: The Drowned Abbess. Those iron anchors keep the floor anchored against the tide.

speaker: vanguard
text: Break the anchors, turn the sluice, and she won't have anywhere to hide.

speaker: vanguard
text: I'll hold the sluice wheel! You cross the dry channel and clear the gate!

speaker: riftweaver
text: Moving! Don't let go until I'm on solid flagstone!

speaker: vanguard
text: Took a sip, saved the rest for you.

speaker: riftweaver
text: Warm brew. Tastes like home hearth honey.

speaker: riftweaver
text: Still quiet. Listen to the drops echoing off the vaulting.

speaker: vanguard
text: A quiet breath before the next wave. I like having you here.

speaker: vanguard
text: The hearth fire's warm tonight. Look at the stars above the chimney.

speaker: riftweaver
text: One more star rekindled. Because we went out together.
